en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an outdoor gymnastics or athletic display. A line of young men in uniform outfits perform synchronized exercises on a large open ground, while a crowd of spectators watches from the sidelines and from a terrace in front of multi‑story houses in the background. Greek text is printed beneath the image and there is a faint circular emblem on the left plus the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right.
